changeSet.comment: Re-create fk_ict_encounter_hts_uuid on hts_ict_encounter with CASCADE rules. hts_encounter is a parent of hts_ict_encounter — deletes/updates on the parent must propagate to child rows.
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE hts_ict_encounter DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_ict_encounter_hts_uuid;
ALTER TABLE hts_ict_encounter ADD CONSTRAINT fk_ict_encounter_hts_uuid FOREIGN KEY (hts_encounter_uuid) REFERENCES hts_encounter(uuid) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE;
changeSet.rollback:
ALTER TABLE hts_ict_encounter DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_ict_encounter_hts_uuid;
ALTER TABLE hts_ict_encounter ADD CONSTRAINT fk_ict_encounter_hts_uuid FOREIGN KEY (hts_encounter_uuid) REFERENCES hts_encounter(uuid) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION;
